senses.gloss: m. (a denom. of כְּרֵתָן, כָּרֵתִי, formed after the Greek πράσινον) leek-colored, green. Y’lamd. to Gen. XLIX, 1 quot. in Ar. בין תכלת לצבע כ׳ (Ber. I, 2 לכרתי), v. כָּרֵתִי.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:6:5">Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ</cite> (ref. to Mish. <he>ירוק ככרתן</he>, v. <cite ref="K01286"><he>כָּרֵתִי</he></cite>) <he>כהן כ׳ או דדמי להן כרתינין</he> (corr. acc.) does the Mishnah mean exactly as green as leek, or any shade like leek?
